Game Overview

In Battleship Match3, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Battleship Match3 doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Battleship Match3?

Battleship Match3 is a free board game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Battleship Match3 free to play?

Yes, Battleship Match3 is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
